invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: The invite-only program. Each company gets its own link: when the founder opens it, their organization is ready at once with the free days, and they are signed in, filling nothing.
invites.empty: No invites yet. Add companies from a sheet to send your first links.
invites.copied: {count, plural, one {# invite copied} other {# invites copied}}. Paste it into a Google Sheet.
